content.rationale: The verb takes its context, names the store and the node path, resolves the --on ids through store_resolve, writes the born document through store_write, opens the change through jj_new, abandons a failed birth's change through jj_abandon (S5-birth-fail, kvwonkzy), brackets through markers_capture, and builds its refusals through refusal; building the gate's own crate typechecks every call at once, so the fan-out is gated without a second owner for the crate.
